name: GD Optimizer
description: Lowers background programs and strips heavy effects so demanding levels run smoother

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Lower the priority of the listed programs while you are inside a level.

processes.name: Programs
processes.description: Comma-separated list of executables to lower while playing.
processes.default: Discord.exe, steamwebhelper.exe, firefox.exe, chrome.exe, msedge.exe, opera.exe

boost-gd.name: Boost Geometry Dash
boost-gd.description: Also raise Geometry Dash to <cy>High</c> priority while inside a level.

restore-on-exit.name: Restore on level exit
restore-on-exit.description: Put every program back to its original priority when you leave the level.

low-detail.name: Force Low Detail
low-detail.description: Turn on <cy>Low Detail Mode</c> in every level (hides the decoration the creator marked as high detail). Your own LDM choice for the level is restored when you leave.

no-glow.name: Remove object glow
no-glow.description: Don't create the glow sprite of blocks. Big boost in decoration-heavy levels.

no-particles.name: Remove level particles
no-particles.description: Disable particle objects placed in the level.

no-shaders.name: Remove shader effects
no-shaders.description: Ignore shader triggers (blur, glitch, shockwave, lens...). These redraw the whole screen and cost a lot of FPS. <cr>Changes how some levels look.</c>
